description: Find out what AI assistants tell buyers about the product: real people ask ChatGPT / Claude (and optionally Gemini, Perplexity, Grok) the product's buying questions from their OWN accounts in a fresh chat, and send back the shared chat link or a screenshot. Once the check ends (default 4 days) the owner generates a report: how often the product comes up, who gets named instead, and the exact words — nothing is probed through an API, and nobody on the panel is paid more when the product's name shows up. COST: one flat launch fee of 1,000 credits at create, whatever the panel size; the panel earns ProductClank points; the report is free. Call with dry_run:true first — it returns the brief and the price and creates nothing — show it to the user, then call again with dry_run:false once they say yes. Give it the buying questions the user cares about (or omit questions to let people ask in their own words). Nothing is posted anywhere.

days.description: How long the panel has to ask (default 4).

dry_run.description: true = return the brief and the price, create nothing, charge nothing. Do this first.

max_participants.description: Panel size: people who may submit an answer (default 40).

models.description: Assistants to ask. Default ChatGPT + Claude.

questions.description: Optional 1–30 buying questions the panel picks from, e.g. 'best analytics tool for solo founders'. Omit to let people ask in their own words.

name: create_ai_visibility_check
title: Check what ChatGPT and Claude say about a product
